GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 072 (30 Nov 46) CPC/FP
(SCAPIN-1371)
APO 500
30 November 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Bank Deposits from Royalty Payments on Patents and Copyrights of United Nations Nationals.
1. The Imperial Japanese Government is directed to report all bank deposits which have been made since 7 December 1941 and which represent royalties on patents or copyrights owned by United Nations nationals. The report will give the name of depositor, the name and owner of the account to which deposit was made, the bank of deposit, and the present total in the account.
2. This report will be submitted to General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers within thirty days from date of this memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
